basis: Congenital structural abnormalities of kidneys and urinary tract.
Neutropenia with lymphocyte deficiency; stomatitis 3/3, gingivitis 2/3 and intellectual disability 2/3; dermatitis 2/2 omitted by cap; infections are separate diagnoses.
Inherited cataract affecting the lens; no established extraocular damage.
Parasitic infection of the eyelid; eyelids belong to the ocular axis.
Bipolar affective disorder is psychiatric; neurological ancestry alone does not establish neurological damage.
Gonadal dysgenesis with hypogonadism; developmental delay 2/2; renal dysplasia/obstruction and anal atresia each 1/2; hearing loss 1/2 omitted by cap.
Young-onset Parkinson disease is a neurodegenerative movement disorder.
Inflammation of the tongue; oral tissues belong to the gastrointestinal axis. Infection or autoimmunity is not inherent.
Anterior segment dysgenesis defines disease; hearing impairment and cardiovascular malformations each annotated 30-79%; dental anomalies are annotated below 30%.
Interferon-mediated autoinflammation; encephalopathy and persistent chilblain skin lesions commonly affect the SAMHD1 spectrum (>30%), with subtype variability.
Skeletal growth disorder with rhizomelia 3/6; hypothyroidism 3/4, cardiac defects 2/5 and hearing impairment 2/5; mild intellectual disability 1/4 is below threshold.
Scarring vesicular photodermatitis; ocular damage is occasional (5-29%), below threshold.
COQ8B-related coenzyme Q10 biosynthesis deficiency causes predominantly renal steroid-resistant nephrotic syndrome.
Acquired deficiency of a coagulation factor; no additional organ damage intrinsic to this diagnosis.
Destructive bone lesion with osteolysis; calcium loss from bone does not itself establish a systemic metabolic disorder.
Sickling hemoglobinopathy affecting erythrocytes and spleen; nephropathy, osteonecrosis and acute chest syndrome are separately diagnosed complications.
Vaginal inflammation is reproductive; this etiologically mixed umbrella includes noninfectious forms and does not itself establish infection or immune-mediated disease.
Thymic epithelial carcinoma has no listed anatomical axis; EBV association does not make the carcinoma an infection, immunodeficiency or lymphoma.
Tumor originates in the fallopian tube, a reproductive organ; resemblance to gastrointestinal epithelium does not establish gastrointestinal involvement.
Steatotic liver disease; metabolic associations do not independently establish an endocrine or systemic metabolic disorder.
Immunodeficiency with defining persistent HPV-related cutaneous verrucosis; recurrent otitis is a separate infection without established lasting ear damage.
Inherited open-angle glaucoma damages the ocular optic nerve; no extraocular involvement established.
Carcinoma originates in breast tissue, which has no axis in this scheme.
Schwann-cell tumor with gastrointestinal wall occupation in roughly half of reported cases; subcutaneous sites occur, but their aggregate frequency is uncertain.
Cerebral arteriopathy with infarcts and leukoencephalopathy; alopecia 5/6 and structural spondylosis/osteoporosis 30-79% support skin and skeletal involvement.
